relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, we suggest that anti‐CGRP MAb therapy was effective after reintroduction in a second period of treatment.

key_findings: In 360 patients, reintroduction of anti-CGRP mAbs after worsening gave 30% response in about 75-80%, but only about one third regained the first-period improvement at 3 months.
Earlier migraine onset, chronic migraine and NSAID/triptan overuse predicted poorer response to resumption.
